mapper.select: SELECT c.*,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''),u.username,'已删除账号') AS author_name FROM afv_canvas_revision c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=c.created_by WHERE c.canvas_id = #{canvasId} AND c.revision < #{beforeRevision} ORDER BY c.revision DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT c.*,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname,''),u.username,'已删除账号') AS author_name FROM afv_canvas_revision c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=c.created_by WHERE c.canvas_id = #{canvasId} AND c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_canvas_revision(id, canvas_id, title, revision, sequence_no, snapshot_json, created_by, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{canvasId}, #{title}, #{revision}, #{sequence}, #{snapshot}, #{actor}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
